title: Understanding a shared principle
meaning: Knowledge can support your shared view when it has passed through reflection of your own and become genuinely understandable to both people.
text: Knowledge can feel closer once you understand a familiar principle for yourselves. The Hierophant in the physical position of Ajna suggests comparing experience with established teaching. The Hermit in energy supports a deep search for meaning of your own. The Hierophant in emotions responds with trust in understood knowledge. Action consults a shared foundation while feeling recognises its dependability.

Suppose you examine principles for reading historical sources and discuss the familiar idea of context. One document seems clear until information appears about the situation in which it was written. **Reflection of your own turns a shared formula into understandable footing.** You see why a separate phrase cannot supply the whole answer. The principle gains a connection with particular material. Trust comes through grasped meaning: you can explain what changed through knowing the circumstances. Shared knowledge acquires personal depth while interest remains in examining other cases.

The difficulty is seeking complete inward agreement with a principle before considering it useful. A search for depth can continue around an example already understood. Independent reflection retains value while acknowledging a current limit. One observation became clearer while others still need attention. Shared footing can be dependable within that scale, leaving each person free to reflect further without immediately covering the whole subject.
